unit.why: A short anecdote: weeks before his death, the tzaddik's disciple, the Maggid of Kozhnitz, and another hasid enter before dawn and witness him pacing and pleading with God about his yihudim.

stories.start_quote: פעם אחד איזה שבועות קודם פטירתו
stories.summary_en: Some weeks before his death, his disciple the holy rabbi of Kozhnitz and another famous hasid came to him before dawn. They saw him pacing back and forth, clasping his hands and crying to God: what will You do for Your great Name, for is there anyone else who performs the holy unifications of Your Name as I do?

quotes: אשר מיחד שמך הגדול יחודים הקדושים כמוני
tags.why: He speaks of his own performance of holy unifications of the divine Name.
Contemplative yihudim are his distinctive practice.

quotes: היה נכנס תלמידו אדמו״ר ההק' מקאזניץ
tags.why: His disciple, the Kozhnitzer, comes to him and witnesses the scene.
He addresses God directly in a plea.

quotes: הולך הנה והנה וחובק את ידיו ובכח
tags.why: He is shown absorbed in intense, rapt worship before dawn.

quotes: קודם אור הבקר וראו אותו הולך הנה והנה
tags.why: He is in private pre-dawn devotion when they enter.
The scene is framed by his approaching death, though the death itself is not depicted.

missing_concepts: tzaddik pleading with God to be spared from death because his service is irreplaceable
the tzaddik's awareness of his own unique spiritual role
